_doc: Arcadia Dungeon example config for the current development schema. This file is seeded on first boot and can be copied as a base for a custom dungeon.
_doc_schemaVersion: Current config schema. Development builds are strict: update JSON when the schema changes.
_doc_nameKey: Displayed name. Can be an i18n key or a literal string.
_doc_currency: Arcadia currency awarded at the end of a run.
_doc_lives: Shared life pool for the group.
_doc_players: Lobby size. The leader can launch only when minPlayers is reached; maxPlayers share one dungeon instance.
_doc_rooms: Reserved for future room metadata. Wave order is now configured by the top-level waves array.
_doc_waves: Global dungeon wave sequence. triggerMode can be ordered or ticks. ordered waits for the previous wave; ticks uses delayTicks since dungeon start.

waves._doc: Wave 2: timed wave, spawned 30 ticks after run start.
waves.name: Wave 2

_doc_bosses: Dungeon bosses. At least one boss is required.
_doc_rewards: Victory rewards. Defeat applies the configured defeat multiplier in code.
_doc_structureRef: NBT structure to place when using template generation. Null means an already built custom dungeon.
_doc_dimension: Dimension where the dungeon template is placed and players are teleported.
_doc_placementY: Forced Y for the NBT origin.
_doc_archetypes: Deprecated per-dungeon classes kept empty. Free player classes are configured globally.
